_comment: Manual curation decisions (ADR-0005). Every entry must state its reason. Reviewer: Claude Code main session, 2026-11-26 (self-review, not external validation).

intel-4004-min-clock-period.reason: Primary source (Intel MCS-4 datasheet) not read: value comes from a third-party transcription (pyntel4004) that does not cite its source; Intel secondary figures diverge (108 kHz / 740 kHz / 750 kHz). Held back until the original datasheet is consulted.

intel-4004-max-clock-frequency.reason: Derived from intel-4004-min-clock-period, which is held back (primary datasheet not read).

osu-latency-crossroads-8b.reason: Incomplete protocol: interconnect, MPI library, sample count and which of the two required tests (longest/shortest path, Table 4.6) produced the value are not stated. Verifier flagged it at the limit of 'inadequate'.

patch.protocol: LANL Crossroads acceptance results: osu_latency, 2 nodes, 1 rank per node, 8-byte message. Not stated: interconnect, MPI library, sample count, and which of the two required tests (Table 4.6) produced the value.

samsung-990pro-qd1-read-latency-derived.reason: Derived with Little's law from an 'up to' marketing IOPS figure with unstated block size: at most a lower bound on mean latency, misleading on a timeline of typical values.

azure-rtt-eastus-westeurope.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Azure backbone round-trip probes between region pairs; statistic: median (P50) over a 30-day window ending 2026-07-30. Not stated by the source: sample count, probe type, quantile method.

azure-rtt-eastus-westus.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Same protocol as azure-rtt-eastus-westeurope (Azure backbone probes, 30-day P50, window ending 2026-07-30). Sample count and method not stated.

azure-rtt-westeurope-francecentral.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Same protocol as azure-rtt-eastus-westeurope (Azure backbone probes, 30-day P50, window ending 2026-07-30). Sample count and method not stated.

azure-rtt-eastus-australiaeast.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Same protocol as azure-rtt-eastus-westeurope (Azure backbone probes, 30-day P50, window ending 2026-07-30). Sample count and method not stated.

human-simple-visual-reaction-time.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Woods et al. 2015: n = 1469 adults (18-65 y); lateralised visual stimuli; response = mouse press with dominant index finger; value = sample mean corrected for 17.8 ms hardware delay (raw 231 ms).

human-stimulus-detection-time.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Woods et al. 2015, same sample (n = 1469): detection time estimated as simple reaction time minus finger-tapping movement-initiation time (derived by the authors).

human-voluntary-blink-duration.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Kwon et al. 2013: n = 25 healthy volunteers (25-63 y); voluntary blinks filmed with high-speed video at 600 fps; mean reported (± 25 ms, dispersion statistic not specified in text).

human-voluntary-blink-closing-phase.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Kwon et al. 2013, same protocol (n = 25, 600 fps video); closing-phase duration, mean ± s.e.

human-flicker-fusion-uniform.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Davis et al. 2015: n = 10 subjects; spatially uniform modulated light from a DLP projector; frequency at which flicker sensitivity falls to zero.

human-flicker-artifact-edge-median.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Davis et al. 2015: n = 10 subjects (two of them authors); modulated light with a sharp spatial edge; median viewer's highest frequency at which artefacts are visible.

human-stylus-latency-jnd-large-box.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Ng et al. CHI 2014: n = 16 naive adults; 1 ms baseline stylus system; just-noticeable latency difference estimated by PEST adaptive staircase; dragging task with large box; median across participants.

human-stylus-latency-jnd-small-box.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Ng et al. CHI 2014: same protocol (n = 16, PEST, 1 ms baseline), dragging task with small box; median across participants.

human-stylus-latency-jnd-scribbling.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Ng et al. CHI 2014: same protocol (n = 16, PEST), scribbling task with 7 ms baseline; median across participants.

x86-add-r64-latency-alderlake-p.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: uops.info automated microbenchmarks executed on an Alder Lake-P CPU (latency of a dependency chain through the register operand). Sample count, frequency and OS not extracted.

x86-imul-r64-latency-alderlake-p.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: uops.info automated microbenchmarks on Alder Lake-P (dependency-chain latency). Sample count, frequency and OS not extracted.

x86-div-r64-latency-alderlake-p.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: uops.info automated microbenchmarks on Alder Lake-P; latency varies with operand values (14-18 cycles); lower bound retained. Sample count not extracted.

x86-div-r64-latency-skylake.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: uops.info automated microbenchmarks on Skylake; latency depends on operand values (ranges per operand pair given in conditions). Sample count not extracted.

x86-div-r64-latency-zen4.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Agner Fog instruction tables: measurements with the author's test programs on AMD Zen 4; latency depends on operand values (10-18). Test details not extracted.

dram-latency-epyc-7702-measured.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Velten et al. ICPE 2022: BenchIT x86-membench pointer chasing; dual-socket EPYC 7702 at nominal 2.0 GHz; local CCX memory; transparent huge pages; caches flushed before measurement.

dram-latency-xeon-6248-measured.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Velten et al. ICPE 2022: BenchIT x86-membench pointer chasing; dual-socket Xeon Gold 6248, same SNC domain, uncore fixed at 2.4 GHz, hardware prefetchers disabled.

dram-latency-pentiumpro-lmbench-1995.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: McVoy & Staelin, lmbench (USENIX 1996): memory read latency by strided dependent load chain; Pentium Pro 200 MHz, Linux 1.3.37.

lmbench-null-syscall-linux-pentiumpro.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: lmbench (USENIX 1996): null system call measured as writing one word to /dev/null in a loop; Pentium Pro 200 MHz, Linux 1.3.37.

lmbench-context-switch-linux-pentiumpro.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: lmbench (USENIX 1996): context switch between 2 processes passing a token, 0 KB working set; Pentium Pro 200 MHz, Linux 1.3.37.

slingshot-rosetta-switch-latency.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: De Sensi et al. (Slingshot, SC 2020): switch latency computed as 2-hop minus 1-hop latency with RoCE traffic from standard NICs; mean and median reported; sample count not extracted.

solidigm-p5620-qd1-write-p999999.reason: Protocol written explicitly from the verified source description (review M-1, 2026-11-26).

patch.protocol: Solidigm product brief footnote: fio, 100% random write, QD1, 99.9999th percentile; 2x Xeon Gold 6254, CentOS 8.2, kernel 5.4.49, C-states and HT disabled; block size not stated.

exos-x20-spindle-frequency.reason: Input is the 7200 RPM documented in the cited Seagate data sheet (review M-2).

solidigm-p5520-4k-qd16-latency-derived.reason: Input is the 233,700 IOPS (4 KiB, QD16) documented in the cited Solidigm brief (review M-2). Value recomputed to 5 significant digits (16 / 233700 s = 68.464 µs) instead of the extraction's rounded 68.5 µs (calculated-value oracle).

linux-tick-period-hz1000.reason: Input is the HZ_1000 Kconfig option (1000 Hz) documented in the cited Kconfig source, not the 250 Hz default item (review M-3).

patch.calculationFormula: T = 1 / HZ with HZ = 1000 (Kconfig option HZ_1000) = 1 ms

frame-time-60hz.reason: Stored at full precision (review m-1: rounding only at display, CS-03); extraction had rounded the calculated value.
